etiology.dr_mechanism: Significant microvascular permeability with flame/blot hemorrhages and lipid exudation.
etiology.dme_mechanism: Clinically Significant Macular Edema (CSME): exudates/edema involving central fovea.

recommendation.clinical_plan: Intravitreal Anti-VEGF therapy and/or Panretinal Photocoagulation (PRP).
